response.sql: WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS average_quantity, (SUM(derived_product_cost) - SUM(derived_total_cost)) / NULLIF(SUM(derived_total_cost), 0) AS relative_gap FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_quantity) AS overall_average_quantity FROM invoice_stats) SELECT invoice_number, average_quantity, relative_gap, average_quantity - overall_average_quantity AS quantity_difference FROM invoice_stats CROSS JOIN overall WHERE average_quantity > overall_average_quantity ORDER BY quantity_difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
